Messages.Author: Shankar Gupta
Messages.Body:
Two questions regarding master cards:

1) When does the card Leadership Vacuum burn, aside from the conditions
listed in the card text? If it's put into play against your prey, and your
prey is ousted, does it burn, or does it just kind of hang out in play for
the rest of the game?

2) Concerning OOT Master Cards that are playable on your turn. Let's say
Leadership Vacuum is in my ash heap, and I use a master phase action to
cycle it back into my hand using Anthelios. Can I then play it during my
turn, or has my Master Phase action not yet "refreshed?"

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Shankar Gupta wrote:
> Two questions regarding master cards:
> 1) When does the card Leadership Vacuum burn, aside from the conditions
> listed in the card text? If it's put into play against your prey, and your

When its controller is ousted.
When yielded (via contest).

> prey is ousted, does it burn, or does it just kind of hang out in play for
> the rest of the game?

It hangs out (until contested and yielded or you are ousted).

> 2) Concerning OOT Master Cards that are playable on your turn. Let's say
> Leadership Vacuum is in my ash heap, and I use a master phase action to
> cycle it back into my hand using Anthelios. Can I then play it during my
> turn, or has my Master Phase action not yet "refreshed?"

?
You can, since M:OOTs are played against your next master phase.
